versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of stock-prediction-daily.
- Provides seven major capabilities: model training/optimization (XGBoost, feature selection), daily prediction and evaluation (Tencent data), web dashboard (Flask), and sector/stock analysis (via other skills).
- Clear project structure with dedicated scripts and data directories; all workflows are self-contained.
- Web interface supports multi-page dashboards, structured report viewing, and auto-formatted report content.
- Strict report formatting and storage guidelines enhance consistency and downstream automation.
